collection.title: Abarth 600e 2024 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Abarth 600e 2024 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
